title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Colors!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends go on a colorful adventure! With Bella's bright ideas, they explore different colors in their world. Together, they learn that colors make everything more fun and exciting!
lesson: Kids learn about colors and how to identify them.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, Twinkle, and Marjona gather in the garden. They remember their last adventures and how fun learning can be. Baby Leo asks, 'What will we learn today?'
Bella jumps up and says, 'Let's learn about colors! I have a fun idea!' Marjona claps her hands and sings a little song about colors.
The friends decide to go on a treasure hunt. Bella wants to find objects of different colors around the garden. Everyone cheers with excitement!
They start noticing colorful flowers. Baby Leo points to a red flower and says, 'Look! Red!' Bobo hops over and adds, 'And here’s a yellow one!'
Twinkle flies up high and says, 'Let’s see what else we can find!' She glows brightly, lighting up the dark corners of the garden.
As they explore, Bobo spots a blue butterfly. He shouts, 'Blue! I found blue!' Everyone gathers around to see the beautiful butterfly.
Suddenly, they find a big box full of colorful crayons. Marjona suggests, 'Let’s draw with them!' They all agree and sit down excitedly.
While they draw, Bella reminds everyone, 'We can use colors to express our feelings!' They share their colorful drawings, and each one shows a different emotion.
At the end, Baby Leo says, 'Colors make everything beautiful!' The friends laugh and cheer as they admire their art together.
They promise to find more colors tomorrow. Together, they celebrate their colorful adventure with smiles!
